subject: @abh/core GetProjection redaction, ListProjection pagination and Mission result surfacing
coverage: GetProjection applies a fixed MissionSummary field allowlist after authorization
completed Mission resultRefs persist on the source record and surface through MissionSummary
businessStageRef and resultRefs participate in server-side field redaction
unknown fields, duplicate fields and unsupported projection types are rejected
ListProjection uses a descending (updated_at,id) keyset with default 25 and maximum 100
registered mission status and domain filters are bound as values; dynamic fields are not accepted
every row rechecks abh.projections.read and denied subjects are skipped without identity disclosure
scanning continues across denied rows so permission filtering does not create missing pages
pc1 cursors use AES-256-GCM binding for identity, epochs, workspace, purpose, type and filters
cursor tampering, filter changes and timestamp precision loss are covered
limits: SubscribeChanges, SSE reset and subscription cursors remain
ResponsibilityInbox, ActionTimeline, OrganizationSettings and CapabilityOverview projections remain
